captions.detailed: This 3D model features a diagonally sliced Menger sponge fractal balanced on a cylindrical support base. The fractal portion is cut along its diagonal plane, exposing a flat, hollowed-out hexagonal cross-section filled with recursive square voids. The bottom corner of the remaining half-cube rests inside a matching conical indentation on top of the cylindrical stand, which is detailed with three vertical slotted cutouts spaced evenly around its perimeter.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric Menger sponge generator in OpenSCAD with options for fractal recursion level, custom cube size, and diagonal cutting. Include a cylindrical support base designed to hold the diagonally oriented or sliced sponge securely with a customizable intersection depth.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'mengersponge' module using recursive subtraction of 'cube' primitives to form the fractal up to order 3. Depending on the 'choice' parameter ('support', 'cut', or 'both'), the sponge is rotated diagonally using 'rotate([45, 90-atan(sqrt(2)), 0])' and positioned. The support stand is constructed by differencing a solid cylinder with an inverted cone (cylinder with r1=0) and three rotated rectangular prisms (cubes) to form the vertical slots, then unioned or differenced with the sponge and a clipping cube to achieve the flat diagonal cut.
